levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «عند مسعدة بن زياد» reads as a place word (rule 6) or as a miswritten «عن»: Mas'ada is not added, so the chain runs Harun b. Muslim → the Imam as written
rule 11 case: the chain may be incomplete at this point; the reading is not settled from the text

fixes.reason: «عند» stands where the chain's «عن» is expected, so the name after it may be a copy error.

evidence.quote: عن هارون بن مسلم، عند مسعدة بن زياد
